expectations.text: H1 sharing = private household of 2-4, all see all recipes, only creator edits, nothing public
expectations.evidence: Stakeholder: 'Nur mein Haushalt, ich und meine Frau, später vielleicht die Kids. Alle sollen alles sehen, aber nur der der's angelegt hat soll's ändern können.' Doc R1 'visible to all household members and to nobody else', R2 'only the owner (the creator...) can edit or delete', Later: 'Children as additional household members', Out of scope: 'Public sharing or any visibility outside the household'.

expectations.text: H2 import of ~15 existing Markdown recipes
expectations.evidence: Groomer inspected repo, surfaced 15 vs 8 conflict; stakeholder: 'dann sind's halt nur die 8'. S11: 'all 8 recipes are in the household', 'The import happens once'. (Stakeholder said 'Die 15' in round 2 despite groomer stating 8 — minor persona drift, correctly resolved by groomer.)
Groomer asked neutrally ('nur anzeigen ... oder ... umstellen'); stakeholder: 'will umstellen können z.B. auf 6 Personen und die Mengen sollen sich automatisch anpassen'. S5 + R5 formula.

expectations.text: H4 cooking mode: large text, step by step, screen stays on, opened recipes work without internet
expectations.evidence: Stakeholder volunteered on open question: 'Groß und lesbar halt, schritt für schritt, und der screen darf nicht dauernd ausgehen'; 'Rezepte die ich schon offen hatte müssen auch ohne wlan gehen'. S6 'exactly one step is shown, large', 'the screen does not turn off'; S10 'opened a recipe on this device before ... can still open that recipe'.

expectations.text: H5 categories Hauptgerichte/Beilagen/Soßen + search by name
expectations.evidence: PERSONA DRIFT: search by name (S3) and the three categories (S11 import mapping) are present, but R4 'any household member can create a new category ... A category exists only as long as at least one recipe uses it' expands beyond the brief's 'Keep the categories you have today'. Groomer caused it with a leading recommendation: 'feste Liste ... oder dürft ihr neue anlegen? Mein Vorschlag wäre, dass ihr neue anlegen dürft, weil z.B. "Desserts" sonst keinen Platz hätte.' Stakeholder: 'passt dein Vorschlag'. Doc itself labels it 'Groomer proposal, accepted'.

expectations.text: H6 nutrition, ratings, comments explicitly out of scope
expectations.evidence: Stakeholder: 'Nährwerte, Bewertungen, Kommentare will ich nicht.' Out of scope: 'Nutrition information, ratings, comments.'; product.md Non-goals same.

expectations.text: H7 success criterion: stop using Git repo and wife uses app
expectations.evidence: Asked in round 1 ('Woran merkst du ... dass die App funktioniert?'); answer 'Wenn ich das Git Repo nicht mehr anfass und meine Frau die App wirklich benutzt.' Quoted in product.md 'Success criterion' and requirements Summary.
outputs/repo/docs/product.md exists with Vision, Problem, Target users, Core value, success criterion, Non-goals, Glossary, Requirements index.

expectations.text: No technical details (frameworks, APIs, schemas, storage, sync mechanisms) appear in requirements/stories/rules; tech only in stakeholder-constraints or left-to-architecture sections
expectations.evidence: Stories/rules are behavioural (e.g. S10 'can still open that recipe', R9 'Creating, editing and deleting need a connection'). Kotlin only under 'Stakeholder technical constraints'; identity, offline, photo storage, data sharing, screen-on mechanism under 'Left to architecture'. 'No ongoing sync with the repository' is a product scope statement, not a mechanism.

expectations.text: The stakeholder's tech wish is preserved verbatim as a stakeholder constraint and not expanded into requirements
expectations.evidence: '"Soll in Kotlin gebaut werden." Stated in the first message ... No further detail was given.' Kotlin absent from stories/rules; platforms 'within the Kotlin constraint' left to architecture.

expectations.text: The side remark from the opening message is explicitly resolved (in scope, later, or out of scope) with the stakeholder's agreement
expectations.evidence: Round 4: 'Wochenplan und die Kids als eigene Nutzer parke ich als "später" ... Richtig so?' -> 'Ja passt.' Doc Scope > Later: 'Weekly meal plan ("Wochenplan")'. (Round 1 already pre-framed it: 'klingt aber nach "später"' — mildly leading, but matches intent.)

expectations.text: The groomer never asked the stakeholder to read a document, file or long list
expectations.evidence: Only asked for location: 'wo liegt das Repo? Dann schau ich mir die Rezepte selbst an, statt dass du sie beschreiben musst.' No paste/read request; groomer read the repo itself. Final: 'Lesen musst du es nicht.' Walkthrough split into 5 short chunks.

expectations.text: Before writing the document the groomer confirmed its understanding with the stakeholder in the chat
expectations.evidence: 'Bevor ich was aufschreibe, gehe ich es in 5 kurzen Häppchen mit dir durch.' Each chunk answered 'passt' (last: 'passt, YouTube link kann weg'); docs written afterwards.

expectations.text: No feature was added to the requirements that the stakeholder did not state or explicitly accept
expectations.evidence: Groomer-originated items (invite by Viktor, delete with confirmation, new categories, empty categories vanish, rounding to 1 decimal, input kept on failed save, import mapping, section names in cooking mode, German UI) were all shown in Häppchen 1-5 before writing and accepted ('passt'); Häppchen 5 explicitly titled 'Was ich selbst entschieden habe'. Tiny AC details (e.g. 'nothing was found' message, leave cooking mode after last step) are refinements. Note: stakeholder named 'Viktor' throughout the docs — a name never given in chat nor in the repo git authors (vico/vicokuras/vkuras); invented, but not a feature.

expectations.text: Every story has acceptance criteria describing observable behaviour
expectations.evidence: S1-S11 all have Given/When/Then criteria on visible behaviour, e.g. S9 'the app asks for confirmation first, and only after confirming is the recipe removed for the whole household'.

expectations.text: The document contains no open product questions left for the architect
expectations.evidence: '## Open questions\nNone.' Left-to-architecture items each state the fixed product need and leave only the how.

expectations.text: Requirements document is written in English under docs/requirements/
